run_collision_filter_demo: run the pybullet collision filter demo that loads a plane and cube with collision filtering enabled
create_collision_filter_group_mask: create a pybullet script that sets collision filter group and mask on a loaded URDF body
enable_collision_pair: enable or disable collision between a specific pair of bodies using setCollisionFilterPair
load_urdf_with_collision_filter: load a URDF model into pybullet and configure its collision filter group and mask settings
set_gravity_and_simulate: set gravity in pybullet and run a real-time simulation loop while connected
